CUSTOMER ACTION — Create account (agency, email, password)

CHAPTER 2 — Customer portal / account
CUSTOMER — Portal home (next action + recent orders)
CUSTOMER — Orders list (empty for a brand-new account)

From the customer perspective, onboarding is complete when the account is Active / ready to order.
CHAPTER 3 — Matt & Aaron setup process (operator-provisioned client)
LAL INTERNAL — Admin C.O.C. Clients & Subaccounts
LAL INTERNAL ACTION — Create client (status defaults to onboarding, portal off)
LAL INTERNAL ACTION — Enable portal + set login email, then generate invite
LAL INTERNAL — Invite is copy-link only. No email is sent. TTL 48 hours.
LAL INTERNAL — Channel profile / settings (optional for portal login)
LAL INTERNAL — Delivery config is for CRM/GHL fulfillment, not a portal-login gate
CUSTOMER ACTION — Open invite link, choose password, then sign in
CHAPTER 4 — Internal approval / handoff
LAL INTERNAL — Front Office Lead Ordering: confirm payment, then approve
LAL INTERNAL — Fulfillment Ops: activate / select / export / Approve & Release
Onboarding ends here. Fulfillment owns activate, package, and release.
CHAPTER 5 — Common troubleshooting
Symptom: missing/invalid invite → Invite unavailable (generic copy, no enumeration)
Symptom: login failure — Email or password is incorrect. Forgot password is available.
Forgot password: generic success. Email sends only if Resend is configured.
If onboarding is stuck: check client status, portal enabled, password status, outstanding invite.
Walkthrough complete. Local test data only. No production writes.
